title: Rock art from at least 67,800 years ago in Sulawesi
bibliographicNote: Nature 650, 652–656. Full publisher PDF read. Rock art dating results and Figs. 2–3: LMET2 calcite 71.6 ± 3.8 ka, conservative minimum for the stencil 67.8 ka. The uncertainty is not subtracted twice. Implications section explicitly states that the maker’s taxon cannot be directly established; Homo sapiens attribution is an inference. Fig. 1 supports only the broad site-orientation point. Article figures are CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 and are linked, not redistributed.
